entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Isaac at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes, I hope you can help. I'm a bit... lost. I bought some cycling shoes a while back, and I just don't think they work for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you happen to have your order number?
Um, I think so... one second. It's VF55124. I tried them, you know, with the cleats and everything, but they just gave me awful blisters on my heels. I'm so overwhelmed by it all.

I'm sorry to hear that. Let me pull up that order. VF55124... Okay, I see the purchase of the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered about 46 days ago. Just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the shoe itself, or more of a sizing or preference issue?
A fault? I... I don't know, maybe? They just hurt. I looked at the return policy on the website, and I couldn't make sense of it. Can't you just help me? I'd really like to get a refund if possible.
Of course, I'm happy to clarify that for you. Let me just take a look at the policy details for this item. One moment, please.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked the policy, and you're all set. Our standard items, like these shoes, have a 90-day return window.
Wait, really? 90 days? Oh, that's such a relief. I was so worried I was too late. So I can send them back for a full refund?

That's correct. Since your purchase is well within that 90-day period, you're eligible for a full refund. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to you. Simply package the shoes up, attach the label, and you can drop them off at any postal service location.
Wow. Thank you so much, Isaac! You've made this so simple. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it! Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
